propositions: test_concurrent_processes_through_seam_both_succeed flakes in CI when one concurrent writer's git commit fails with rc=1 and empty stderr due to a shared index race between add and commit operations

the race occurs because add and commit are two separate run_git_write calls each holding the advisory lock independently, allowing beta's add to stage beta.txt, then alpha's commit to sweep up both files, leaving nothing for beta's commit
test assertions report only stderr and omit git stdout and the command name, making empty-stderr failures undiagnosable from CI logs without reproduction
fix requires each worker to commit only its own pathspec instead of the whole index, so a writer losing the interleaving still has its own change to commit
the production contention policy in rebar._store.gitutil is correct; the defect is test-only in how it serializes its operations
